title: Formal charge of an atom in a Lewis diagram

items.label: FC
items.meaning: formal charge of the atom (in units of elementary charge, e)

items.label: V
items.meaning: number of valence electrons in the free, neutral atom

items.label: N
items.meaning: number of nonbonding (lone-pair) electrons on the atom in the Lewis diagram

items.label: B
items.meaning: number of bonding electrons around the atom in the Lewis diagram (each shared pair counts 2, so B/2 is the number of bonds to the atom)

caution: The CED requires students to calculate and use formal charges but does not print this expression. Apply it to a valid Lewis diagram with the correct total valence electron count. Formal charges in a species sum to the overall charge. Use them with the octet rule to choose the best of several valid diagrams (2.6.A.2); they are not real charges on atoms.
ced_evidence: 2.6.A.2 "The octet rule and formal charge can be used as criteria for determining which of several possible valid Lewis diagrams provides the best model"; Unit 2 Preparing for the AP Exam: "calculating and connecting formal charges in Lewis structures"
